statement: In an interaction-dominated zero-sum game, smaller first-order momentum beta permits a broader stable Adam-DA step-size range.
domain: Quadratic zero-sum game with Jacobian eigenvalues -1 plus/minus 3i; beta in {-0.3,0,0.3,0.6,0.9}.
pass_condition: A fixed-criterion binary search returns a strictly decreasing maximum stable h as beta increases.
